system.description:
The Ravnos can make any Chimerstry illusion, no matter how outlandish, be believed as unquestionably real by all who witness it — or, used inversely, make something genuinely real seem so unbelievable that witnesses dismiss it as a trick.

System: The Ravnos rolls Manipulation + Subterfuge (difficulty 7); the number of successes determines how many witnesses are affected (1 success = 5 people, 2 = 10, 3 = 25, 4 = 50, 5 = everyone who can perceive it).

MET: Master Discipline. The Ravnos spends three Social Traits. Any witness who has some reason to disbelieve must win a Static Social Challenge (difficulty equal to the Ravnos's current Social Traits) or believe the illusion implicitly, with no further chance to question it that scene.
